title: Verification Profile v0
description: A versioned disclosure and evidence rule set for a Proof Bundle. Unknown object properties are retained and reported as warnings by readers; unknown enum values remain invalid for this version-pinned contract.

version.description: The fixed version of this v0 profile contract.

description.description: A human-readable statement of the disclosure policy.

required_evidence_kinds.description: Evidence classifications required for a complete export under this profile.

omit_paths.description: Source-relative glob patterns for evidence that this profile omits.

omit_kinds.description: Normalized evidence classifications that this profile omits.

items.description: One normalized evidence classification to omit.

field_redactions.description: Derived record fields that this profile redacts without rewriting file evidence.

field.description: The logical field path selected for redaction.

reason.description: The privacy or disclosure rule that requires redaction.

secret_scan.description: The scan categories that fail export or cause an item to be omitted.

fail_on.description: Secret classes that cause public export to fail without revealing the value.

items.description: One secret class that fails export.

omit_on.description: Privacy classes that omit an affected item while preserving a disclosure record. Applied only when masking did not already publish the item.

items.description: One privacy class that omits an affected item.

mask_on.description: Privacy classes that publish an affected item with the matched text masked, rather than withholding it.

items.description: One privacy class that masks an affected item.

mask_kinds.description: Evidence kinds this profile may publish masked. Restricted to kinds the Compiler projects nothing but findings out of, because a masked item's published bytes differ from its source and proof.json must not assert facts the Bundle cannot show.

items.description: One evidence kind that may be published masked.

max_bundle_bytes.description: The maximum preferred deterministic managed-output size in bytes, excluding transport metadata.

max_item_bytes.description: The maximum preferred size of one included evidence item in bytes.

require_reviewed_equals_head.description: Whether the Loop-Verified badge requires the reviewed and head commits to match.
